summary:
GROUNDPULSE – The Ground Beneath Us is an AI-powered environmental monitoring and risk assessment platform designed to identify and understand changes occurring beneath the Earth's surface. The platform integrates satellite-based observations, including Landsat optical imagery, GRACE water storage measurements, and InSAR radar displacement data, to assess environmental changes such as water loss, vegetation stress, groundwater depletion, and land subsidence.

Using a multi-indicator AI-based risk assessment engine, GROUNDPULSE combines these observations to generate risk scores, confidence levels, and understandable findings. Users can select predefined environmental hotspots or analyze custom geographical regions through an interactive map interface. The platform also provides historical analysis, recommendations, and downloadable PDF reports.

Our goal is to transform complex Earth observation data into accessible insights that support environmental awareness, informed decision-making, and sustainable management of Earth's resources.
details:
Project Overview

GROUNDPULSE – The Ground Beneath Us is an AI-powered environmental monitoring and risk assessment platform that uses satellite-based Earth observation data to identify and understand changes occurring beneath the Earth's surface.

Our project uses three types of satellite observations:

  1. NASA/USGS Landsat Data: We use optical satellite imagery to examine changes in land cover, vegetation health, and surface water over selected geographical areas and time periods. This helps identify vegetation stress and changes in water bodies.
  2. NASA GRACE and GRACE-FO Data: We use satellite-based measurements of changes in Earth's gravity to study terrestrial water storage variations. These observations help assess water loss, water stress, and possible groundwater depletion.
  3. Satellite SAR/InSAR Data: We use radar-based observations to identify ground movement and land subsidence. These measurements help highlight areas experiencing changes in surface elevation.

The platform processes these observations through separate analysis pipelines and combines the resulting indicators using an AI-based risk assessment engine built with PyTorch and Scikit-learn. It generates environmental risk scores, risk categories, confidence levels, plain-language findings, and recommendations.

Users can select predefined environmental hotspots or choose a custom geographical region, compare different time periods, explore the analysis results, and download reports in PDF format.

By combining satellite observations with AI-based analysis, GROUNDPULSE aims to transform complex Earth observation information into understandable insights that support environmental monitoring, water-resource awareness, and informed decision-making.
